newsitem.title: USA: Schlumberger profits surge 56 percent in quarter.
newsitem.headline: Schlumberger profits surge 56 percent in quarter.

text.p: Schlumberger Ltd. said Wednesday its net income surged 56 percent in the second quarter to $307 million, or 62 cents a share, as the performance of all its diversified businesses improved.
The New York-based company makes measurement instruments, and provides communications and information technology.
Schlumberger earned $196.7 million, or 40 cents per share, in the year-ago period. Operating revenue jumped 21 percent in the second quarter to $2.6 billion from $2.2 billion.

For the first six months of 1997, earnings surged 54 percent to $566.4 million, or $1.15 per share, from $367.6 million, or 75 cents per share. Operating revenue grew 20 percent to $5.0 billion from $4.2 billion.
Schlumberger said its oilfield services revenue grew 30 percent, while its rig count worldwide grew 17 percent.
Measurement and systems revenues rose 4 percent, while operating income grew 26 percent, it said.
Schlumberger's stock rose $2.06 to $77.06 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
